newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate edges down to 7.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate edges down to 7.7 pct.

text.p: Croatia's money market weighted rate, weighed down by high supply, eased back to 7.7 percent on Thursday from 9.1 percent.
Trade rose to 26.4 million kuna made at a rate of 7.6 percent for call money, against almost double supply of 40 million kuna. Dealers said 20 million kuna accounted for new loans.
Insurers rolled over five-10 placements at a steady 7.0 percent and a smaller long term loan was struck at 9.6 percent.
Dealers said two banks squared their Wednesday's overnight shortfalls of 0.6 million kuna and one bank bought 80 million kuna to maintain its reserve payment.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrate for Friday weaker at 5.4599 to the dollar and 3.5646 to the mark. --Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
